notes.title: First Update - Extra Content and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
In response to initial user feedback, 
Let's Learn Japanese Katakana has been given its first update.

Some players were keen for more practice reading complete words in Katakana. Now there's a new mini-game dedicated to word reading: it's at the end of Level 24!

There have also been a few bug reports related to sound and layout when playing on certain hardware specifications. 
These bugs have been found and exterminated, let me know about any I've missed!

Dr. Cyril.
